authority.rule: A generated image passes only when every required measurement exists, no hard-fail rule fires, and both aesthetic judges meet the adoption threshold.
authority.conflict_resolution: identity, serving-state, brand, leakage and layout hard-fail rules override aesthetic scores

provider_boundary.overflow_policy: block the full request; never silently remove an input

hard_fail: wrong exact-product count
wrong product identity
wrong hot or cold serving state
floating or detached support contact
undeclared duplicate exact product
removed reference slot or relation reappears as authority

required_active_items: one exact right-front cold matcha beverage
one complete round dark oiled-wood tray
representative_a6_scale_contract.structured_only_policy: experimental fallback only because the provider enlarges the tray group without spatial image evidence

representative_white_basic_contract.handoff_provider: OpenAI Images API through the ComfyUI OpenAI workflow
representative_white_basic_contract.scene: one complete product on a matte white table beneath a large warm-neutral white wall

lighting.source: one very large diffused window source from the left
lighting.shadow: soft, spatially attached contact and cast shadow

representative_white_basic_contract.adopted_container: unbranded short straight-sided clear glass with fine vertical fluting, a thin circular rim and an understated flat base
hard_fail: direct sunbeam, bright light patch or graphic hard shadow
product exceeds the contracted height or width
meaningful negative space is below 0.68
hero-product or advertising close-up composition
shadowless studio sweep
portrait-mode cutout or uniform background blur
invented logo, lettering or pseudo-brand
the result reads as a repeatable AI minimalist product template
representative_white_basic_contract.evidence_status: selected GPT result is a revise-and-review visual baseline, not a published preset
representative_white_basic_contract.provider_portability: preserve input roles, final prompt, quality, output size, postprocess and hashes; record a new request hash and job id when moving from Higgsfield to the OpenAI API

transfer_requirements: source and target are both verified branded
hard_fail: invented text or logo
reference branding copied
logo appears on an unbranded target
incorrect glyph on an exact-brand target
material-board boundary visible
source object, text or layout copied from material input
wood color or grain treated as lighting authority

lighting.authority: lighting sheet controls source type, direction, size, hardness, shadow density and white balance
lighting.material_separation: wood color, grain and finish remain material-profile authority
hard_fail: conflicting light directions
fake or detached shadows
hardness is identical across near and far planes when the contract separates them
clipped ceramic whites
full-frame amber or brown veil
product reads as a pasted cutout or sticker
source boundary, source reflection or source perspective is preserved
scene-hint panel edge or swatch boundary leaks into the result
identifiable reference object, furniture, text, logo or exact shadow silhouette is copied

hard_reject: light or shadow is visibly artificial
cup, drink, dessert or hand detail is malformed
the result reads as an AI mood photograph
the product is buried or commercially unusable

iteration_policy.rule: Change one diagnosed variable family per iteration and keep model, quality, resolution, seed, product and reference invariant.
iteration_policy.publication: A preset remains draft until schema, hash, zero-credit workflow and visual review all pass
